summary: The blocking R4 finding is valid and should be repaired by separating normal npm test coverage from flow-local spec-local coverage.

items.title: R4 conflicts with the existing npm test boundary for spec-local tests
items.rationale: The spec currently implies spec-local tests are part of normal npm test detection. Existing flow conventions treat spec-local tests as flow-local coverage, so R4 must require shared unit/e2e coverage for npm test while retaining spec-local tests for flow coverage.
items.evidence: spec.json R4 and AC R4 mention normal npm test and spec-local tests together; spec review cites test runner boundaries that exclude specs/ from normal npm test.
